channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period's coverage highlights real investment momentum: a $244.5M FEMA infrastructure disbursement, DOE's $490M loan closing for Pattern Energy's 220MW battery storage buildout, MVP Toyota's $11M Caguas dealership, continued expansion at PRISA's $550M Distrito T-Mobile, and South Korea's Hanil Electric scouting Puerto Rico as an Americas hub. Financial-sector signals were positive too, with Banesco USA posting 59% net income growth and San Juan successfully returning to the direct municipal bond market alongside a debut Act 60 private-equity investment.
